freeTierSummary.zh-CN: LightVela 是腾讯 Lighthouse 构建的云端 Hermes Agent。官网标注新用户可免费试用 1 个月并附带 AI 积分，激活后可通过 OpenAI 兼容接口 token.lightvela.ai 调用 auto 模型。积分额度、消耗规则与活动期限以控制台和官方文档为准。
freeTierSummary.en: LightVela is a cloud Hermes Agent built by Tencent Lighthouse. The site advertises a 1-month free trial with AI credits for new users; after activation the auto model is available over the OpenAI-compatible endpoint token.lightvela.ai. Credit amounts, usage rules and promo terms are subject to the console and official docs.
